releases.name: Version 2.0.0
releases.body:
V2.0.0

Modified the detection and identification radiuses for various signals

Removed all "Absorption" signals

Renamed "LOOP_ERROR" signal (Advanced Core)(bonus: This sound can now be heard without the signalscope...)

Renamed "Emission" signal (White Core)

Added new signals (Ash Twin Mask) to each of the active masks within the ATP

Added a new signal to the  Major White Hole (White Hole)
releases.bodyZh:
V2.0.0

修改了各种信号的检测和识别半径

移除了所有"吸收"信号

重命名了"LOOP_ERROR"信号（高级核心）（奖励：现在可以在没有信号镜的情况下听到这个声音...）

重命名了"Emission"信号（白洞核心）

为ATP内的每个活跃面具添加了新的信号（灰烬双星面具）

为主要的白洞（白洞）添加了一个新信号

releases.name: Content Release
releases.body:
This release coincides with the Repository rework

V1.0.0 Added a new signal (LOOP_ERROR) and frequency (Anti-Graviton Flux) to the Advanced Warp Core, Added a new signal (Emission) to all White Hole cores (Anti-Graviton Flux), Added a new signal (Absorption) to all Black Hole cores (Anti-Graviton Flux), Added a new signal (Sun Station) to the Sun Station (Nomai Radio), Added new signals (Moon & Comet Shuttle) to the Nomai Shuttles (Nomai Radio), Added new signals (Museusm, Island, & Probe Statue) and frequency (Nomai Statue) to the Activated Nomai Statues
